d: Theatre of the Austrian Glory, in which they are seen painted, and sculpted his feats interwoven with various trophies, and with the equestrian statues of all the emperors of the most august house. The Austrian Glory over the Pegasus horse in the air; its very happy states in two choirs, in the one Empire, the Kingdom of Hungary, Italy, and Sardinia, in the other Spain, America, the Kingdom of Bohemia, and the Capital State of Germany; Love, and Himmenaeus over two clouds.
Pluto's palace. Proserpina followed by the Belidi.
Proserpina, Pluto courted by various Spirits, and Hell monsters.
Discord over a dragon, Pluto, Proserpina.

King of Jupiter with the feast of the gods. Jupiter, Juno, Pallas, Venus, Apollos, Mars, Neptune, Bacchus, Mercury, Ebe cupbearer of Jupiter. Ganymede cupbearer of the other Gods. Momo buffone, choir of Semidei, who serves at the table.
Jupiter, and the other Gods, Ganymede. Momo, the Discordia in a cloud passing over the table without being seen by the Convitati.
Selva d'Ida.
Paris, Ennon.

Momo, Paris.
Paris, Momo, Juno, coming down from the sky in a large gallery filled with gold, scepter joys, crowns, etc.
Paris, Momo, Pallade armed, which descends from the sky under a grand triumphal arch, seated between various remains, and trophies.
In Venus' illusion the scene changes in the garden of pleasure. Venus courted by a choir of the Ideas of various beauties, and by a choir of Love, Paris, Momo.
Seaport, Filaura, Aurindo.
Momo, Filaura.
Paris alone.
Ennon, Philaura, Paride.

Bocca d'inferno. It opens the earth, from which, rising a huge, and monstrous head, which occupies the whole scene, opens its jaws in a vast chasm, in which you can see the infernal river, with Charon boating on the shore, and in the distance the city of Dite surrounded by flames.
Aletto, Tesiphon, Megera, with bundles in hand.
Paris, chorus of his servants.
Venus, Love over a chariot in the air.
Cecrope, Adrasto, choir of soldiers.
Cecrope, Pallas over a chariot in the air, Adrasto, choir of Soldati.
Cecrope, Alceste his bride.
Tritonia swamp. Two Padrini with two squadrons of Donzelle armed like Amazons.
There's a cloud in which you can see Pallade armed... 2 Padrini with the Squadrons.
Cave of Eolo. Eolo, Euro, Austro, Zeffiro, Volturno.
Juno over a cloud, Eolo, choir of twenty.
It goes with the river Xanto, which flows through it.
Ennon, Aurindo.
Momo, Aurindo.
Arsenal of Mars. Venus, Mars, coming.
Paris, chorus of his servants in a vessel.
Paris, and its Choir, Venus over a shell with a choir of Nereids, Neptune, which comes up from the sea, Tritoni's choir.
Scramble alone.
Aurindo, Filaura.
Cecrope, choir of his soldiers.
Cecrope, Chorus of his own, Mars, Chorus of his own.

Pallas in the air over a cloud. Priest, Choir of ministers, Adrastus.
Alone moose.
Airplane with the Milky Way, and above the sphere of the fire. Venus in its star.
Venus, Love over a chariot of fire coming from the sphere of the same.
Juno above the starry chariot of Arturo, which walks through the Milky Way formed of very small stars, Venus.
The element of the Foco over a chariot pulled by two great salamanders, Juno.
Atrium of the palace of Venus. Euphrosine, one of the graces, over a turtle.
Aglaie, Pasithea, Euphrosine.

They appear in triumph Venus, and Mars with Cecrope on their chained feet, seated on a chariot pulled by two lions ridden by the Amorins; ahead we see the pump of triumph with the remains of Juno, and Pallas, i.e. scepters, crowns, weapons, and books and followers of Cecropes captives; a winged figure representing Victory in the end of the chariot raises a triumphant crown over the head of Mars, and above that of Venus the golden apple; with the continuation of a choir of Soldati.
Love in flight, which rests on the chariot; Venus, Mars.
Fortress of Mars. Alceste, Adrasto, choir of Soldati.
Pallas above his chariot in the air. Alceste, Adrasto, choir of Soldati.
Delightful villa of Paris. Ennon.
Philaura, Ennon, Momo.
Juno in a dark cloud, Jupiter over the eagle, which comes.
Momo, Juno as above.
Lonely ennon.
Aurindo, Ennon.
Philaura, Ennon, Aurindo.
Momo, Ennono, Aurindo, Filaura.

Piazza del castello di Marte with its palace in the façade and in the middle of a secluded tower. The sky opens, where in its throne Jupiter is majesticly seated with the eagle at the feet of Juno near him, Pallas and a large choir of various Deities. Jupiter, Juno, Pallas, choir of Gods.
Venus above his chariot rises from the fortress to heaven. Jupiter, Juno, Pallas, Venus, choir of Gods.
